newsitem.title: VIETNAM: War-era bomb kills six in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: War-era bomb kills six in Vietnam.

text.p: Five children and a man were killed in southern Vietnam when a war-era bomb exploded and ripped through the man's house, a local official said on Thursday.
The official in Binh Thuan province, speaking by telephone, said 36-year-old Nguyen Van Dinh triggered the blast by trying to saw through the casing of the U.S.-made bomb to remove its explosives.
Neighbours had advised Dinh not to tamper with the bomb and then fled when he continued. But five curious children, four of whom were from the same family, stayed behind and were caught in the blast.
Unexploded ordnance from the Vietnam War, which ended in 1975, remains a lethal hazard in many areas of Vietnam, killing dozens of people every year.
